data.name: Advent Arena
data.detailed_description:
Lead your forces, assembled from heroes through space and time, to victory in the arena! Countless magical creatures, quirky robots, spooky ghosts, valiant humans, and their combined array of spells are all at your disposal. Do whatever it takes to destroy the enemy tower before they destroy yours!

Battle against other players online and put your strategies and skills to the test in real-time tower defense combat. Units move towards the enemy tower and engage targets in their way automatically. Spells can land anywhere, anytime, you want. Interact with fights as they happen, but manage your deck cycle and spend your limited mana wisely!

This card game runs in real-time! No waiting for your turn, adapt and respond immediately! An assassin is about to jump on your sniper? Intercept it with a wall! Your forces are about to be swarmed and overrun by an enormous flock of robot birds? FIREBALL!

Pick a hero, each providing unique ways to outmaneuver or overwhelm your opponents. They'll defend your tower and support your army with a myriad of specialties and abilities. Level them up to add special cards to your deck or provide global buffs or other bonuses.

Craft your own unique way to destroy a tower. Mix and match cards from any faction to craft your strategy. Control the objectives to level up faster? Go all-in early to go for a knockout? Bait the enemy before pulling out your secret weapon? These and many more, it's all up to you!

Features:

  • Real-time competitive tower-defense.

    • Matches take 3-8 minutes each, easy to fit in anywhere.

    • Interact with fights as they unfold.

  • Solo and cooperative play.

  • Low skill floor, high skill ceiling. Easy to learn, difficult to master.

    • No micromanagement required.

    • All cards and heroes are obtainable for free.

  • Jokes.

    • All puns are obtainable for free.

data.short_description: A card-game/tower-defense hybrid. Play solo or with a partner to level up your hero, summon creatures, and cast spells to take down your foes in online multiplayer. Employ any of many diverse strategies in quick matches. Collect and deploy every unique and quirky hero and card for free.
